ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels; high-intensity pixels are concentrated on lateral lobes, low-intensity in the central and trailing edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-contrast white contiguous blobs on the distal sections of both lobes. Central peduncle insertion area and the majority of the trailing edge surface are mapped to dark-grey/black pigmentation with diffuse transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 95 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; left lobe contains deeper pixel-amplitude valleys (notches) compared to the right; right lobe shows more consistent micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature relative to the top edge, with a distinct upward sweep and convex distal margins ending in thickened tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, brownish-white pixel groups localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; scattered white circular pixel points visible across the dark central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, thin white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected on the mid-to-distal section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue buildup/thickening at both fluke tips consistent with heavy colonization or previous trauma; distinct rake marks visible on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'chunky' texture at the distal tips of the lobes where pixel depth and intensity vary significantly from the smooth fluke boundary.
